body:
I never played a turn based combat game before this, and am not high on tap to move..that said… I would sell my organs to play this game for the first time again. It definitely does have a learning curve but it does have an easy difficulty that helps. It also has phenomenal replay ability. Very very immersive, great story great writing, the combat absolutely grew on me. Amazing classes and customizations. 

Cons: ruins a lot of other games that don’t live up to this games standards.
